commits.message: decodeAnsi resets its charsets at RIS and DECSTR, and overstrikes as emphasis only in ASCII; the docs box closes (review of #577)
decodeAnsi draws the designated character set: DEC Special Graphics in G0 or G1, shifted by SO and SI (rich-control-codes-xh4n.hdm)

decodeAnsi moves along the line for CUB, CUF, CHA, HPR and HPA as it does for BS and CR (rich-control-codes-xh4n.9pb) (#576)

* decodeAnsi moves along the line for CUB, CUF, CHA, HPR and HPA as it does for BS and CR (rich-control-codes-xh4n.9pb)
